component.name: Fedora Glass
component.summary: A glass look for GNOME and your apps, from clear to frosted
Ein Glas-Look für GNOME und Ihre Apps, von klar bis milchig
Un aspecto de cristal para GNOME y tus aplicaciones, de transparente a esmerilado
Un style verre pour GNOME et vos applications, du transparent au dépoli
Un aspetto in vetro per GNOME e le tue app, da trasparente a satinato
Um visual de vidro para o GNOME e seus aplicativos, do transparente ao fosco

description.p: Fedora Glass gives GNOME Shell, GTK and Qt apps a glass look, drawn by its own GNOME Shell extension: the top bar, menus, the overview, the lock screen and the windows. A customizer app tunes it from clear liquid glass to calm frost.

Fedora Glass gibt GNOME Shell sowie GTK- und Qt-Apps einen Glas-Look, gezeichnet von einer eigenen GNOME-Shell-Erweiterung: obere Leiste, Menüs, Übersicht, Sperrbildschirm und Fenster. Eine Anpassungs-App stellt ihn von klarem Flüssigglas bis zu ruhigem Milchglas ein.

Fedora Glass da a GNOME Shell y a las aplicaciones GTK y Qt un aspecto de cristal, dibujado por su propia extensión de GNOME Shell: la barra superior, los menús, la vista de actividades, la pantalla de bloqueo y las ventanas. Una aplicación de personalización lo ajusta desde el cristal líquido transparente hasta el esmerilado suave.

Fedora Glass donne à GNOME Shell et aux applications GTK et Qt un style verre, dessiné par sa propre extension de GNOME Shell : la barre supérieure, les menus, la vue d’ensemble, l’écran de verrouillage et les fenêtres. Une application de personnalisation permet de le régler, du verre liquide transparent au verre dépoli.

Fedora Glass dà a GNOME Shell e alle app GTK e Qt un aspetto in vetro, disegnato da una propria estensione di GNOME Shell: la barra superiore, i menu, la panoramica, la schermata di blocco e le finestre. Un’app di personalizzazione lo regola dal vetro liquido trasparente al satinato.

O Fedora Glass dá ao GNOME Shell e aos aplicativos GTK e Qt um visual de vidro, desenhado por uma extensão própria do GNOME Shell: a barra superior, os menus, a visão geral, a tela de bloqueio e as janelas. Um aplicativo de personalização ajusta o efeito, do vidro líquido transparente ao vidro fosco.
It changes only your own user settings, can put your original look back at any time, and works with Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu and Spawn, or on stock GNOME with none of them.

Es ändert nur Ihre eigenen Benutzereinstellungen, kann Ihren ursprünglichen Stil jederzeit wiederherstellen und arbeitet mit Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu und Spawn zusammen – oder auf einem unveränderten GNOME ganz ohne sie.

Solo cambia tus propios ajustes de usuario, puede devolver tu aspecto original en cualquier momento y funciona con Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu y Spawn, o en un GNOME sin modificar y sin ninguno de ellos.

Il ne modifie que vos propres réglages d’utilisateur, peut rétablir votre style d’origine à tout moment et fonctionne avec Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu et Spawn, ou sur un GNOME standard sans aucun d’eux.

Modifica solo le tue impostazioni utente, può ripristinare il tuo aspetto originale in qualsiasi momento e funziona con Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu e Spawn, oppure su un GNOME standard senza nessuno di essi.

Ele altera apenas as suas próprias configurações de usuário, pode devolver o seu visual original a qualquer momento e funciona com Dash to Panel, Dash to Dock, ArcMenu e Spawn, ou em um GNOME padrão sem nenhum deles.

description.p: New: the box shown when you drag a window to a screen edge is glass, Day and night switches between two saved looks with GNOME's light and dark style, apps can have their own glass strength, saved looks can be updated, and there is an Edge reflections slider.
More apps get the look: Kitty, Ghostty, Alacritty, Foot, WezTerm and VSCodium, and Flatpak or Snap installs of Obsidian, VS Code, qBittorrent, Ptyxis and Firefox are found.
Apply and the switch between dark and light are faster, sliders are smoother, Style set to Dark or Light is followed by all apps, and several smaller bugs are fixed.
The taskbar no longer flashes as the pointer passes its middle, and the pointer's light turns smoothly across menus and the taskbar.
Slack, Discord, VS Code and other apps that draw their own window get glass behind their title bar again, instead of a see-through bar showing the desktop.
The taskbar no longer flickers when you drag along it, and a new How liquid slider makes the press effect firmer or more liquid.
Apps without glass get a solid window, the app shows when the glass is paused and can resume it, and a wallpaper-matched look follows a new wallpaper by itself.
One restart is enough after an update, a correct wallpaper notice when light and dark switch, looks save to USB sticks, and more wallpapers work with Match my wallpaper.
Now in German, French, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese, following your system language.
Sturdier: a failed Apply or a damaged settings file never changes your look, a lighter background helper, faster window drags, and many app fixes.
New: saved and shared looks, plain-language changes, one step back, wallpaper colours, Firefox colours, lighter glass on battery, apps without glass, and a Glass switch in Quick Settings.
A preview big enough to judge the glass, close up by default, and a little less memory.
A simpler app: a sidebar of pages, search for settings, and a faster start.
Mouse pointer styles, clearer app, safer backups, and signing that checks where a release was built.
Less memory, cheaper glass, lighter window drags and less idle CPU.
Full-screen games get direct display again, and hidden window glass frees its memory.
